paths.F-dense: frozen E1 probe probabilities from the E1 cache, every 10 Hz sample of the sequence (as the original evaluation)
paths.F-grid: F-dense read only at the window target samples c (window_centres, stride 5), filled back by nearest_centre
paths.J-dense: softmax of the same checkpoint's auxiliary frame head on that checkpoint's encoder features, every sample
paths.J-grid: J-dense read only at the same c and filled back by the same rule
paths.T-window: the checkpoint's temporal Transformer and window head on B7's 16-frame windows, offsets s - c, stride 5, filled back by nearest_centre (the previous round's argmax row)
